crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they…
to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive…
that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the…
having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches…

translations.web: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.
translations.bsb: Ears that hear and eyes that see— the LORD has made them both.
translations.kjv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both
translations.asv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Jehovah hath made even both of them.
